hooks.name: Format frontend (ESLint + Prettier)
hooks.description: After saving a TS/TSX/CSS file in the frontend, auto-format with Prettier and auto-fix with ESLint.

action.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24.22.1 >/dev/null 2>&1; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)/frontend" && pnpm exec prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" >/dev/null 2>&1; pnpm exec eslint --fix >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
